name: starzero
description: Upload media to StarZero, search transcripts and visuals, run workflow templates, cut podcast clips and share renders through the starzero CLI.

api_key.title: StarZero API key
api_key.description: Create a key at https://app.starzero.ai/settings/api-keys with the profile:read, billing:read, library:read, library:search, rendering:read and rendering:write scopes, then paste it here. Claude Code stores it securely, outside your settings file.

confirm_billed_commands.title: Ask before spending credits
confirm_billed_commands.description: Show a confirmation, with the estimated cost, before uploads, workflow runs, podcast clips, chat turns and clean renders, which all use StarZero credits. Off means those commands run without a confirmation.
